title: Rc Capabilities
objective: Implement a machine-readable release capability and provenance report that distinguishes compiled, bundled, fallback, unavailable, cold, and warm state without triggering builds.

handoff.summary: Added a standalone, observational release capability and provenance reporter with stable JSON and concise human output. It separates installed native state (compiled, bundled, unavailable), selected execution (native, fallback, compile-on-first-use, unavailable), and cold/warm readiness; checks generated adapter hashes without loading addons; reports source/package/SEA artifact context, version, Git provenance, host and Node ABI, selected-versus-installed native math profiles, and redacted cache locations. Nine focused tests cover clean and dirty source concepts, cold and warm caches, native-disable fallback, tampering, mathematical SEA assets, Windows M4RI fallback, profile mismatch, path privacy, read-only behavior, and standalone output.
risks: Exact selected native-math fingerprints require compiler/toolchain probes, so this observational report intentionally compares effective profile names and labels the selection probe not-run.
Platform behavior is simulated in the focused corpus; integration should exercise the standalone report inside real Linux and macOS release artifacts.
The full portable tier currently also needs native dependencies materialized in this isolated worktree.
next_steps: The integration lane must register test/release-capabilities.cjs in test/node-test-manifest.cjs, which is outside this lane's claims, then record the portable-tier receipt.
Wire collectReleaseCapabilities and formatReleaseCapabilities into the public release diagnostics command without changing their observational-only contract.
Run the report from clean npm and SEA artifacts and retain its JSON beside release checksums and provenance.
